## Authors / Editors
- 朱謀垔 (明朝) 撰

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Zhū Móuyīn's five-*juàn* biographical history of painting from highest antiquity through the Míng — the painting complement to Táo Zōngyí's earlier [KR3h0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3h/KR3h0043) *Shūshǐ huìyào* (which covered calligraphy only). Completed in *Chóngzhēn xīnwèi* (1631), the work gathers painters' names and biographies and appends a *Huàfǎ* (technical methods) section in its final *juàn*. The Sìkù editors fault the work for some editorial errors: the Jīn-Yuán order is muddled (Jīn placed before Yuán); the Míng emperors Tàizǔ and Xuānzōng are placed after the foreign painters (preserving an old organisational quirk); the *mùlù* and the actual text disagree on the placement of Northern and Southern Sòng. Yet the work is the principal Míng biographical reference for Sòng-Jīn-Yuán and early-Míng painting, and the Kāngxī *Pèiwénzhāi shūhuà pǔ* draws extensively on it.

**Abstract**

Zhū Móuyīn 朱謀垔 (also written 朱謀堙; *zì* Yīnzhī 隱之, *hào* Yīnxiánzhě 隱閒者) was a late-Míng imperial-clansman scholar of the Níngfán branch (descended from Zhū Quán 朱權, the Yǒng-lè-era *Níngwáng*). The clan was based at Nánchāng 南昌. Zhū Móuyīn was an enormous compiler: in addition to the *Huàshǐ huìyào* he produced numerous *lèishū*-style reference works and historiographical studies. The painting *Huàshǐ huìyào* is one of the principal Míng painting reference works and a major source for the Kāngxī [KR3h0061](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3h/KR3h0061) *Pèiwénzhāi shūhuà pǔ*. The Sìkù editors' criticism, citing Gù Yánwǔ's [KR3j0107](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3j/KR3j0107) *Rìzhī lù*, is part of the wider Qīng critique of late-Míng *Chán*-influenced scholarly sloppiness.
